'''FC Nyva Vinnytsia''' is a Ukrainian professional [[association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Vinnytsia]]. The name "Nyva" translates to "grain field". The club was created in 1958 in the [[Soviet Union]] and folded in 2005 and 2012, but was reformed again in 2015 as Nyva-V and renamed back to Nyva in 2018. Since 2021, the club has been owned by one of their players."}}
